title: MTG x-mtg extension schema v0.1.0
description: Schema for the x-mtg extension block inside a JSON Schema string property. Describes linguistic constraints on the value.

slot_type.description: Linguistic slot the parameter occupies. Determines whether morphological analysis is applied.

script.description: Required Unicode script for the value.

dialect_expected.description: Expected dialect register. Only applicable when script='ar'.

dialect_enforcement.description: How strictly to check dialect_expected. 'strict' blocks in enforced mode, 'preserve' warns, 'advisory' only logs.

transliteration_allowed.description: If false, values in the declared script must not be Romanized (e.g. Arabizi).

morphologically_productive.description: If true, the span is expected to carry morphologically meaningful structure (root+pattern). Enables morph analysis.

canonicalization.description: Canonicalization applied to the analysis output.

canonical_form_required.description: If true, the call payload must carry the canonical form in addition to the surface.

mode.description: v0.1.0 ships advisory only. reconciled and enforced are spec-defined but raise NotImplementedError in the reference validator.

post_call_contract.description: Named post-call invariants the tool response must satisfy for this parameter.
